courses.description:
Brahmacharya Classes offer deep, practical, and philosophical clarity for youth on mastering the senses, conquering fear through Krishna consciousness, and understanding why material desires can never bring lasting satisfaction.

Delivered by HG Adbhuta Hari Prabhuji (Monk & Life Coach) at ISKCON Juhu, this free structured course guides sincere seekers toward purposeful living, mental strength, and unwavering devotion to Lord Krishna.
courses.shortDescription: A foundational youth course on fearlessness, overcoming material desires, and spiritual discipline in Brahmacharya by HG Adbhuta Hari Prabhu.
courses.title: Brahmacharya Classes
whatYouWillLearn: Cultivate fearlessness and mental clarity through Krishna Consciousness
Understand the spiritual psychology behind material desires and sense control
Daily sadhana and practical habits for living a purposeful, disciplined life
Direct answers and personal guidance on youth dilemmas and spiritual growth

courses.description:
The Bhagavad Gita series offers a verse-by-verse and thematic exploration of Lord Krishna's timeless dialogue with Arjuna, uncovering practical spiritual wisdom for mental clarity, inner peace, and divine connection.

Delivered every Thursday by HG Adbhuta Hari Prabhuji (Monk & Life Coach) at ISKCON Juhu, this structured course guides students through the deep philosophy of karma, jnana, and bhakti to live with purpose and spiritual excellence.
courses.shortDescription: A transformative Thursday study series on the verses and philosophy of Srimad Bhagavad Gita by HG Adbhuta Hari Prabhuji.
courses.title: Bhagavad Gita
whatYouWillLearn: Gain practical insights from verse-by-verse wisdom of Srimad Bhagavad Gita
Understand the psychological mechanics of the mind, senses, and false ego
Overcome the illusion of control and surrender anxiety to the Supreme
Apply the teachings of Karma Yoga and Bhakti Yoga in contemporary daily life

courses.description:
Chanting the Holy Names (Maha-Mantra) is the foremost spiritual practice in Kali-yuga. Yet, many seekers struggle with wandering thoughts, drowsiness, and lack of taste in Japa.

In this focused guide, HG Hayagriva Charan Das (B.Tech From NIT Raipur) shares transformative, practical, and scripturally grounded methods to bring discipline, attentive listening, and heartfelt absorption into your daily Japa meditation.
courses.shortDescription: Practical techniques and spiritual focus to overcome distractions and deepen your daily chanting meditation by HG Hayagriva Charan Das.
courses.title: How To Improve Your Japa?
whatYouWillLearn: Practical techniques for maintaining posture, alertness, and mind control during Japa
The science of attentive hearing (Sravanam) and purifying wandering thoughts
Understanding the offenses to avoid for rapid spiritual advancement
Developing consistency and genuine taste in chanting the Hare Krishna Maha-Mantra

books.authorOrTranslator: His Divine Grace A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada
books.fullDescription:
Srimad Bhagavatam, known as the spotless Purana, is celebrated as the ripened fruit of the desire tree of Vedic literature. Translated and elucidated by His Divine Grace A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada, it focuses entirely on transcendental devotion and glorifies the divine pastimes and attributes of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

From the philosophical inquiries of King Pariksit and Sukadeva Goswami to the deep wisdom of devotional surrender, the Bhagavatam is a profound lighthouse guiding souls toward pure love of God and eternal joy.
highlights: The complete spotless Purana and cream of Vedic literature
Authentic Sanskrit verses, Roman transliteration and elaborate purports
Immortal pastimes of Supreme Lord Sri Krishna and His pure devotees
A timeless treasure for every home and spiritual institution
books.shortDescription: The spotless Purana presenting the science of Krishna and devotional surrender by A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada.
books.subtitle: The Immaculate Purana by A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada
books.title: Shrimad Bhagavatam

books.authorOrTranslator: His Divine Grace A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada
books.fullDescription:
The Nectar of Devotion is a summary study of Sri Rupa Goswami’s Bhakti-rasamrta-sindhu, authored by His Divine Grace A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada. It systematically presents the science of bhakti-yoga—the path of divine love and devotional service to Lord Krishna.

Covering the fundamental practices of sadhana-bhakti, the symptoms of ecstatic love (bhava-bhakti), and the ultimate perfection of pure unalloyed love of God (prema-bhakti), this masterpiece serves as an indispensable handbook for anyone seeking true spiritual fulfilment.
highlights: The definitive guidebook for the complete science of Bhakti-yoga
Systematic explanation of 64 foundational devotional practices
Illuminates stages of devotional development from faith to pure divine love
Authorized summary study of Srila Rupa Goswami's Bhakti-rasamrta-sindhu
books.shortDescription: A summary study of Srila Rupa Goswami's Bhakti-rasamrta-sindhu, presenting the definitive science of devotional service.
books.subtitle: The Complete Science of Bhakti-Yoga by A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada
books.title: The Nectar of Devotion

books.authorOrTranslator: His Divine Grace A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada
books.fullDescription:
Beyond Birth and Death offers clear, definitive answers to humanity's greatest mysteries: What happens to consciousness after bodily death? Is reincarnation real? How can the soul achieve eternal liberation?

Drawing from the timeless verses of the Bhagavad Gita and ancient Vedic wisdom, His Divine Grace A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada reveals how by practicing simple, authentic bhakti-yoga meditation, anyone can awaken their eternal spiritual identity and transcend material suffering forever.
highlights: The definitive introductory guide to the science of reincarnation and the soul
Explains how the mind and desires shape our next destination
Practical instructions on meditation and awakening eternal spiritual consciousness
Direct insights drawn from the Bhagavad Gita
books.shortDescription: A concise, illuminating guide to the science of the soul, reincarnation, and how to transcend the cycle of repeated birth and death.
books.subtitle: Transcendental Knowledge of Reincarnation and the Soul
books.title: Beyond Birth & Death

books.authorOrTranslator: His Divine Grace A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada
books.fullDescription:
Coming Back: The Science of Reincarnation explores one of life’s most fascinating and misunderstood subjects. Is life after death a fantasy or a scientific reality? How do our current desires and choices determine our future body and circumstances?

Based on the profound teachings of His Divine Grace A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada and the ancient Vedic wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita and Srimad Bhagavatam, this book offers logical explanations, real-world case histories, and practical spiritual guidance for taking control of your spiritual destiny.
highlights: Compelling examination of past-life memories and near-death experiences
Clear, logical explanation of the universal law of karma and rebirth
Reveals how consciousness transmigrates from one body to the next
Practical techniques to break free from the cycle of rebirth
books.shortDescription: An extraordinary, eye-opening exploration into the documented science and Vedic reality of past lives, reincarnation, and destiny.
books.subtitle: The Science of Reincarnation
books.title: Coming Back

The evening is open to everyone, whether or not you have attended before. There is no charge, and prasadam is served to all who stay.
upcomingclasses.whatToExpect:
The evening opens with kirtan — call and response chanting that anyone can join without knowing the words. You do not need to sing; many people simply sit and listen the first time.

The class that follows draws on scripture but is pitched at people living ordinary working lives. Expect roughly forty minutes of talk and twenty of questions, and the questions are genuinely welcome.

We close with prasadam, a full vegetarian meal served to everyone who stays. There is no charge and no expectation that you contribute.

pilgrimages.title: 5-Day Sacred Journey to Vrindavana
pilgrimages.visitDetail: ISKCON Vrindavan, Banke Bihari, Prem Mandir
pilgrimages.shortDescription: A meaningful journey through the sacred temples, ghats and devotional culture of Vrindavan, guided by senior devotees.
pilgrimages.description:
Vrindavan is where Krishna spent his childhood, and walking its lanes is unlike reading about them. Over five days you will visit the temples that have shaped Gaudiya Vaishnava practice for five centuries, join morning kirtan on the banks of the Yamuna, and sit with senior devotees for guided sessions each evening.

This journey is designed for students and working professionals who want more than sightseeing. Mornings are devotional, afternoons are for guided exploration and reflection, and evenings close with aarti and a discussion session.

You do not need prior experience of pilgrimage, and you do not need to be a practising devotee. You need curiosity and a willingness to keep early hours.

pilgrimages.importantInfo:
Reporting time is 5:30 AM at the ISKCON Juhu main gate. Please carry a government photo ID — it is required at accommodation check-in.

Modest dress is expected at all temples: shoulders and knees covered. Leather items are not permitted inside several temples.

One suitcase and one small day bag per traveller. Accommodation is twin-sharing unless arranged otherwise.

Cancellations more than 21 days before departure are refunded in full less transaction charges.

faqs.question: Is transportation included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Return transport from ISKCON Juhu and all local transportation during the trip are included.

faqs.question: What should I bring?
faqs.answer: Modest clothing covering shoulders and knees, comfortable footwear that is easy to remove, a government photo ID, any personal medication, and a reusable water bottle.

faqs.question: Are meals included?
faqs.answer: Daily breakfast and prasadam are included. Other meals are not, so you can choose according to your own preference.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my booking?
faqs.answer: Cancellations more than 21 days before departure are refunded in full less transaction charges.

faqs.question: Can I book for someone else?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add each traveller's name and age in the booking form.

faqs.question: What happens after I pay?
faqs.answer: Upload your payment screenshot with the booking. Our team verifies it, usually within two working days.

pilgrimages.title: 3-Day Mayapur Youth Retreat
pilgrimages.shortDescription: A short, intense retreat for students and young professionals at ISKCON's world headquarters on the banks of the Ganga.
pilgrimages.description:
Mayapur is where Chaitanya Mahaprabhu appeared, and where ISKCON keeps its world headquarters. For three days you will live the daily rhythm of a temple community: up before dawn for mangala aarti, sessions through the day with youth preachers, and evenings of kirtan that tend to run longer than scheduled.

This retreat is built for people in their twenties who are curious but busy. It is deliberately short and deliberately full. Expect early mornings, simple accommodation, long conversations, and very little downtime.
pilgrimages.paymentInstructions: Please add your booking reference in the payment remarks so we can match it quickly.

itinerary.title: Mumbai to Mayapur
itinerary.description: A long travel day that ends with your first darshan.
itinerary.morning: Depart ISKCON Juhu at 4:00 AM for the Kolkata flight.
itinerary.afternoon: Road transfer to Mayapur and dormitory check-in.
itinerary.evening: Sandhya aarti at the Chandrodaya Mandir.

itinerary.title: A Full Day in Mayapur
itinerary.description: The temple day, start to finish.
itinerary.morning: Mangala aarti at 4:00 AM, then Yogapith and the Samadhi Mandir.
itinerary.afternoon: Sessions with youth preachers and time on the Ganga ghats.
itinerary.evening: Kirtan and an open discussion that usually runs late.

itinerary.title: Closing & Return
itinerary.description: Final darshan and the journey home.
itinerary.morning: Mangala aarti, final darshan and group photograph.
itinerary.afternoon: Road transfer to Kolkata and the flight to Mumbai.

inclusions.title: Road transfer Kolkata to Mayapur and back

exclusions.title: Anything not specifically mentioned under inclusions

pilgrimages.importantInfo:
Reporting time is 4:00 AM at the ISKCON Juhu main gate. The flight to Kolkata is early and the group will not wait.

Carry a government photo ID, required for the flight and at check-in.

Accommodation is dormitory style, separated by gender. Mornings start at 4:00 AM for mangala aarti — this is the core of the retreat rather than an optional extra.

faqs.question: Are flights included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Return flights between Mumbai and Kolkata are included, along with the road transfer to Mayapur and back.

faqs.question: What is the accommodation like?
faqs.answer: Dormitory style, separated by gender, within the temple complex. Clean and simple rather than comfortable.

faqs.question: Do I really have to be up at 4 AM?
faqs.answer: Yes. Mangala aarti is the heart of the retreat. If very early mornings are not workable, the Vrindavan journey keeps a gentler schedule.

faqs.question: I have never been to a temple before. Is that a problem?
faqs.answer: Not at all. Several people on every retreat are attending their first.

faqs.question: Can my college group book together?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add everyone as travellers on one booking, or write to the youth office if you are more than ten people.

pilgrimages.title: 2-Day Pandharpur Pilgrimage
pilgrimages.shortDescription: A weekend journey to the temple of Vitthal on the banks of the Chandrabhaga, within reach of a Mumbai weekend.
pilgrimages.description:
Pandharpur is the heart of the Warkari tradition, where pilgrims have walked to see Vitthal for more than seven centuries. This is the shortest of our journeys — leave Saturday morning, back Sunday night — and the easiest for families or anyone who cannot take leave from work.

The pace is gentle. There is darshan, a walk along the Chandrabhaga, and an evening of kirtan with local Warkari singers.

itinerary.title: Mumbai to Pandharpur

itinerary.evening: Vitthal Rukmini darshan and evening aarti.

itinerary.title: Chandrabhaga & Return
itinerary.description: A morning by the river, then home.
itinerary.morning: Sunrise walk along the Chandrabhaga ghats.
itinerary.afternoon: Kirtan with local Warkari singers, then depart.
itinerary.evening: Arrive at ISKCON Juhu by late evening.

pilgrimages.importantInfo:
A coach journey of roughly eight hours each way. Please carry a government photo ID and any medication you need.

The temple can be crowded; the coordinator will brief the group on darshan arrangements on the way.

faqs.question: How long is the coach journey?
faqs.answer: Roughly eight hours each way, with stops.

faqs.question: Is this suitable for older family members?
faqs.answer: Yes. The pace is gentle and there is no parikrama or long walking.

faqs.question: Are meals included?
faqs.answer: All prasadam during the journey is included.
